content: Amenḍar n Israil d weɛdař nnes

“Ad yiři řqedd n ayt n Israil am yejdi n řebḥar i war izemmar ad ittwaɛbar u war izemmar ad ittwaḥseb, uca ad tafed mani d asen nnan: ‘Kenniw war teǧim d řgens inu!’, ad asen ittwanna: ‘Kenniw d iḥenjiren n Arebbi iddaren!’
Ayt n Yahuda d ayt n Israil ad ttwassmunen, ad ggen ijj n umɣar i yixef nsen u ad geɛɛden zi marra temmurt, maɣar ass n Yazraɛil ad yiři d ijj n wass d ameqqran.
Inim i wawmaten nwem: ‘Ɛemmi!’ u i suyᵉtmatwem ‘Ruḥama!’
“Dɛam ak-d yemmatwem, dɛam, maɣar nettat war teǧi d tamɣart inu u Necc war ǧiɣ d aryaz nnes. Ejj i-tt ad tekkes farq-ccɣeř nnes zeg uɣembub nnes uřa d zzina zi jar ibbac nnes.

Niɣ aqa ad as kkseɣ arruḍ ad tt jjeɣ d taɛaryant¸ ad tt ssarseɣ diha am deg wass amezwaru i di dd-texřeq, wah, ad tt arreɣ d ict n řexřa, ad tt arreɣ am yict n temmurt yuẓɣen uca ad tt jjeɣ ad temmet s ufadi.
Necc war arreḥmeɣ x iḥenjiren nnes, maɣar nitni d iḥenjiren i dd-ixeřqen zi farq-ccɣeř.

Maɣar yemmatsen aqa tefsed ixef nnes, wah, tenni tuɣa s ddeyset zzaysen, tegga řefḍiḥet, maɣar teqqar: ‘Ad ḍfareɣ inni d ayi iɛeccqen, inni d ayi itticen aɣrum inu d waman inu d taḍuft inu d tiffest inu d zzect inu d tsessit inu.’
S uya, aqa ad bellɛeɣ abrid nnem s cbarq ak-d isennanen u ad ssbeddeɣ aɣbar nnes, ḥima war tᵉttif ɛad imesraq nnes.

Nettat ad teḍfar inni tt iɛecqen, maca war xasen tḥarret. Nettat ad xasen tarzu, maca war ten tᵉttif. Xenni ad tini: ‘Necc ad ɛeqbeɣ, ad dewřeɣ ɣar weryaz inu amezwaru, maɣar deg wussan nni tuɣa ayi mliḥ x řexxu.’
Nettat war teɛqiř, aqa d Necc i tuɣa d as iwcin imendi d binu n jdid d zzect, u aqa d Necc i tuɣa d as iwcin nnuqart s waṭṭas, uca ureɣ i d asen wciɣ aqa ggin t ɣar Baɛl.
S uya i ɣa ɛeqbeɣ, ad kkseɣ imendi inu di řweqt n ṣṣabet uřa d binu inu n jdid di řweqt nnes ittwaggen u taḍuft inu d tiffest inu i zi teddař tuɛɛaryent nnes ad tent qeřɛeɣ zzayes.
Xenni řexxu ad ɛarriɣ x řeḥya nnes zzat i tiṭṭawin n yinni tt ittexsen uca uřa d ijjen war izemmar ad tt ifekk zeg ifassen inu.
Necc ad ssbeddeɣ marra řefraḥet nnes, uraren nnes, ussan nnes n ubeddi n uyur uřa d ussan nnes n ssebt, wah, marra ussan nnes ittwaggen.
Ad areddǧeɣ tazayart nnes d tcejjart n wartu nnes i zi tenna: ‘Tina d řmunet i d ayi wcin yinni d ayi ittexsen.’ Ad tent arreɣ d ijj n wezɣar u řmař n yeyyar ad zzaysent ccen.
Necc ad tt wteɣ x ussan n ‘Ibaɛlen’, ussan i di tiwi-dd asen tiwhibin n řebxur u tegga taxrazt nnes d tseddect nnes, u teḍfar inni tt ittexsen, maca nettat tᵉttu ayi!”, ammu i iqqar SIDI.
“S uya, xzar, Necc ad tt ɣarreɣ, ad tt nedheɣ ɣar řexřa, u din ad ssiwřeɣ ak-d wuř nnes.
Ssenni ad as wceɣ imarjaɛen nnes n uḍiř u ad arreɣ taɣzurt n Axur d tawwart n řayas. Nettat ad dinni tɣennej am tɣennej deg wussan n temẓi nnes, am x wass umi dd-teffeɣ zi temmurt n Miṣra.
Deg wass nni iqqar SIDI, ad ayi třaɣid: ‘Aryaz inu!’, u war d ayi teqqared ɛad: ‘Baɛl inu!’
Ad as kkseɣ ismawen n ‘Ibaɛlen’ zeg uqemmum nnes. War ttfekkaren ɛad deg ismawen nsen.

Deg wass nni ad ggeɣ ijj n řɛahd di ṭṭweɛ nsen ak-d řewḥuc n řexřa, ak-d ijḍaḍ n ujenna u ak-d imuddaren nni ittbuɛen x wudem n temmurt. Ad kkseɣ řqews d ssif d umenɣi zi temmurt u ad ten ssarreyḥeɣ di řhudnet.
Necc ad cem xeḍbeɣ i řebda, wah, ad cem xeḍbeɣ s tsegda d řheqq, s tmexsiwt icewwaren d arreḥmet.
Necc ad cem xeḍbeɣ s řaman, u cem ad tessned SIDI.
Deg wass nni, iqqar SIDI, ad imsar aqa Necc ad sřeɣ ɣar ujenna u ajenna ad iseř ɣar temmurt
u tammurt ad tseř ɣar imendi uřa ɣar binu n jdid d zzect, u ina ad sřen ɣar Yazraɛil.
Necc ad tt zarɛeɣ i Necc di temmurt u Necc ad arreḥmeɣ x Lu-Ruḥama, u ad iniɣ i Lu-Ɛammi: ‘Cem d řgens inu i teǧid!’, u řgens ad yini: ‘AREBBI inu!’”

footnotes.text: ad ggeɣ- s Tɛibranit ‘ad qesseɣ’. ad kkseɣ- s Tɛibranit ‘ad arẓeɣ’.
